desktop.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: finished background raster art for a frontier slot game, landscape 16:9, 2560x1440 if available.
Input images: image 1 is ONLY the composition, character identity and frontier theme reference; image 2 is the CLEAN FLAT CARTOON ILLUSTRATION STYLE reference.
Primary request: redraw the frontier cast scene in a chunky irreverent adult-cartoon style, visually closer to South Park and Hacksaw slot art. Strong flat 2D shapes, thick slightly irregular dark ink outlines, restrained two-tone cel shadows, deliberately simple exaggerated faces and big readable heads. Match the crisp flat rendering of image 2. This is a comprehensive cartoon style change.
Scene: old-west ghost town at dusk with petrol/navy sky, a simple flat amber moon upper left, a crooked simple windmill, chunky timber western buildings confined to outer edges, blue-black mesa silhouettes in the distance, coherent dark desert floor.
Subjects: exactly two characters preserving the identities from image 1. Far LEFT: scruffy tousled dark-haired masked hunter in an orange long coat over dark clothes, broad chunky silhouette, oversized head, simple small suspicious cartoon eyes, black lower-face mask, boots. Far RIGHT: blue-black robot cowboy in black western hat and long navy coat, simple geometric robot face with tiny cyan eye slits, chunky readable limbs with minimal armor detail, oversized hat/head. Both standing relaxed, full bodies grounded naturally; no guns pointed at viewer.
Composition: characters ENTIRELY in outer 28 percent strips of the canvas; left character head approximately x17% y30%, right head x83% y30%, both boots near y88%. Central 42% must be quiet unobstructed negative space for reels, dark sky and sparse flat ground only. Keep all tall buildings and props at edges. Rich inked silhouettes, balanced composition.
Palette: dark petrol blue, navy, charcoal, muted warm rust and flat amber accents, orange left coat, restrained cyan right accents. Art dark enough for bright slot symbols laid over center but still readable.
Constraints: exactly one final landscape image. No text, typography, logos, game UI, symbols, reels, border, watermark. No anime eyes or anime style, no photorealism, no 3D, no painterly textures, no glossy rendering, no realistic armor, no elaborate lighting, no noisy clouds.

mobile.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: finished mobile background raster art for a frontier slot game, portrait 9:16, high quality.
Input images: image 1 is ONLY the old-west frontier theme and dusk palette reference; image 2 is the CLEAN FLAT CARTOON ILLUSTRATION STYLE reference. Do not reproduce either character from image 1.
Primary request: a dark old-west ghost-town environment in chunky irreverent adult-cartoon / Hacksaw-like flat 2D illustration. Thick slightly irregular dark ink outlines, simple strong silhouettes, restrained two-tone cel shadows, crisp flat shapes as in image 2.
Scene: dark petrol/navy dusk sky, a flat amber moon near upper-left, simple timber ghost-town buildings tightly confined to far left and far right edges, sparse crooked fence and simple windmill at an outer edge, layered blue-black desert mesa silhouettes, dark desert floor across bottom. Only a few small warm amber windows at edges.
Composition: tall portrait 9:16; a very large dark quiet center and top-center left empty for a logo and game board, continuous open sky in upper half and sparse open ground below. Buildings have no large signs, frame only the outer edges, and never intrude into the center 65%. The environment must feel composed specifically for portrait.
Palette: dark petrol blue, navy, charcoal, muted warm rust, flat amber accents; readable yet dark behind bright slot symbols.
Constraints: exactly one final portrait image, NO CHARACTERS, NO PEOPLE, NO ROBOTS, no faces or cast silhouettes. No text, typography, logos, game UI, symbols, reels, border, watermark. No anime, no photorealism, no 3D, no painterly texture, no glossy detail, no dramatic realistic clouds.
